name: deconstruct
description: AI problem deconstruction + schedule-aware routine builder (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @deconstruct/shared && npm run build -w @deconstruct/scheduler && npm run build -w @deconstruct/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @deconstruct/shared && npm run build -w @deconstruct/scheduler && npm run dev -w @deconstruct/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @deconstruct/scheduler && npm run test -w @deconstruct/api
